title: How Saudi Arabia Took on Pro Golf — and Won

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔瓦尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: This morning, fierce reaction after the PGA TOUR's announcement that it's merging with its Saudi-funded rival, Live Golf.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，PGA巡回赛宣布与沙特资助的竞争对手LIV高尔夫合并，引发了强烈反响。

sentences.en: The news of this partnership, a shock to players, media and fans.
sentences.zh: 这一合作的消息让球员、媒体和球迷感到震惊。

sentences.en: In a stunning reversal last week, golf's premier circuit, the PGA TOUR, announced it was partnering with its upstart rival, a controversial league backed by Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 在上周一次令人震惊的逆转中，高尔夫顶级巡回赛PGA宣布与它的新兴竞争对手——一个由沙特阿拉伯支持的争议性联赛——达成合作。

sentences.en: A country that has never won an Olympic gold medal, Saudi Arabia has suddenly emerged as a major player in global sport.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯这个从未获得过奥运金牌的国家，突然成为了全球体育界的主要参与者。

sentences.en: Whether it's gobbling up golf rights or signing yet another global soccer star, many roads now seem to lead to Riyadh.
sentences.zh: 无论是抢购高尔夫赛事转播权，还是签下又一位全球足球巨星，如今许多道路似乎都通向利雅得。

sentences.en: They've invested very heavily in golf, Formula One, WWE, they've had boxing there.
sentences.zh: 他们在高尔夫、一级方程式赛车、WWE上投入了巨资，还在那里举办过拳击比赛。

sentences.en: Now, Saudi Arabia, along with its long record of human rights abuses, has a powerful new seat at the table of international sports.
sentences.zh: 现在，沙特阿拉伯在拥有长期侵犯人权记录的同时，在国际体育界占据了一个强有力的新席位。

sentences.en: A major success in a years-long effort to win influence.
sentences.zh: 这是其多年来争取影响力努力的一项重大成功。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Alan Blinder explains what was behind this surprising turn, what it means for Saudi Arabia, and for the business of sports.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事艾伦·布林德将解释这一惊人转变背后的原因，以及这对沙特阿拉伯和体育产业意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月15日，星期四。

sentences.en: So, Alan, I have to tell you that a group of producers at The Daily were very interested and became, in fact, quite obsessed with the question of Saudi-backed golf,
sentences.zh: 艾伦，我得告诉你，《每日新闻》的一群制片人对沙特支持的高尔夫问题非常感兴趣，甚至到了痴迷的程度，

sentences.en: this live golf league.
sentences.zh: 也就是这个LIV高尔夫联赛。

sentences.en: And I told them, no, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我当时对他们说，不，谢谢。

sentences.en: I do not want to do a podcast about that.
sentences.zh: 我不想做一期关于那个的播客。

sentences.en: And they persisted.
sentences.zh: 但他们坚持不懈。

sentences.en: And then last week, this Saudi-backed league burst into the news.
sentences.zh: 然后上周，这个沙特支持的联赛突然成了新闻热点。

sentences.en: And the team got very excited.
sentences.zh: 团队变得非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And here we are sitting with you doing a podcast about the Saudi-backed league, this live league.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们坐在这里，和你一起做一期关于这个沙特支持的联赛，也就是LIV联赛的播客。

sentences.en: So, for those of us who don't know anything about golf, like me, explain why this was such a big deal.
sentences.zh: 那么，对于像我这样对高尔夫一无所知的人，请解释一下为什么这件事如此重要。

sentences.en: So, until last year, there was an absolutely unquestionably preeminent group in golf.
sentences.zh: 在去年之前，高尔夫领域有一个绝对无可争议的卓越组织。

sentences.en: It's called the PGA Tour.
sentences.zh: 它叫PGA巡回赛。

sentences.en: It was where the biggest stars played.
sentences.zh: 最伟大的球星都在那里打球。

sentences.en: They had played there for eons.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在那里打了很久很久了。

sentences.en: If you wanted to make it big in pro golf, make money, be a star, you went to the PGA Tour, play a lot of tournaments in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在高尔夫职业赛场上出人头地、赚钱、成为明星，你就会去PGA巡回赛，在美国参加很多锦标赛。

sentences.en: And then there's this new league that shows up, the Live Golf Operation.
sentences.zh: 然后出现了一个新的联赛，LIV高尔夫运营公司。

sentences.en: It's funded by Saudi Arabia's Sovereign Wealth Fund.
sentences.zh: 它由沙特阿拉伯的主权财富基金资助。

sentences.en: It showers players with money.
sentences.zh: 它用金钱向球员砸去。

sentences.en: And suddenly, the PGA Tour, for the first time in a long time, maybe even ever, has a real challenger.
sentences.zh: 突然间，PGA巡回赛在很长一段时间以来，甚至可能是有史以来第一次，遇到了真正的挑战者。

sentences.en: The PGA Tour has essentially been a monopoly for a long time, and they weren't going to give it up easily.
sentences.zh: PGA巡回赛长期以来本质上是一个垄断组织，他们不会轻易放弃。

sentences.en: And then it shocked us last week when they popped up on Tuesday morning and essentially said they were merging.
sentences.zh: 然后上周二早上，当他们突然宣布合并时，我们都惊呆了。

sentences.en: And why does it matter, Alan?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，这为什么重要呢？

sentences.en: Like, why does it matter that these two merged?
sentences.zh: 为什么这两者的合并很重要？

sentences.en: It matters a great deal because Saudi Arabia has spent years trying to establish prestige on the global stage, to be a big player around the world, not just in sports,
sentences.zh: 这非常重要，因为沙特阿拉伯多年来一直试图在全球舞台上建立声望，成为世界上的大玩家，不仅是在体育领域，

sentences.en: but culturally, economically, and the like.
sentences.zh: 而且在文化、经济等方面也是如此。

sentences.en: And, look, Saudi Arabia is a country that is oil-rich.
sentences.zh: 看，沙特阿拉伯是一个石油资源丰富的国家。

sentences.en: Its economy is built around oil and natural resources.
sentences.zh: 它的经济建立在石油和自然资源之上。

sentences.en: It's got a human rights record that has been slammed all around the world for almost time immemorial.
sentences.zh: 它的人权记录长期以来一直受到全世界的抨击。

sentences.en: With good reason.
sentences.zh: 而且理由充分。

sentences.en: They were responsible for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the Washington Post columniSt.
sentences.zh: 他们应对《华盛顿邮报》专栏作家贾迈勒·卡舒吉的遇害负责。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there's a long history of human rights abuses that have colored a lot of perceptions of Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，长期以来侵犯人权的历史给沙特阿拉伯的许多形象蒙上了阴影。

sentences.en: But this merger, I mean, this was essentially unimaginable a year ago.
sentences.zh: 但这次合并，我的意思是，这在去年是完全无法想象的。

sentences.en: And here we are now with the Saudis poised to have enormous sway over one of the world's biggest sports for years and years to come.
sentences.zh: 而现在，沙特人准备在未来多年里对世界上最伟大的体育运动之一产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Okay, so Saudi Arabia getting a seat at the table in a big way.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以沙特阿拉伯以一种重要的方式在谈判桌上获得了一席之地。

sentences.en: How did this deal come together?
sentences.zh: 这笔交易是如何达成的？

sentences.en: Where did it all start?
sentences.zh: 这一切是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, a few years ago, the Saudis have the Sovereign Wealth Fund.
sentences.zh: 嗯，几年前，沙特人拥有主权财富基金。

sentences.en: It's one of the world's largeSt.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上最大的基金之一。

sentences.en: They wanted to diversify their economy.
sentences.zh: 他们想实现经济多元化。

sentences.en: They wanted to be about more than oil.
sentences.zh: 他们想不仅仅依赖石油。

sentences.en: So they decide to get into sports as one of their investments.
sentences.zh: 所以他们决定把体育作为他们的投资方向之一。

sentences.en: And golf is one of them.
sentences.zh: 高尔夫就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Initially, they reach out to the PGA Tour.
sentences.zh: 最初，他们联系了PGA巡回赛。

sentences.en: They see, is there a, you know, some kind of alliance to be made, a partnership to be made.
sentences.zh: 他们想看看是否能建立某种联盟或伙伴关系。

sentences.en: And the tour essentially ignores them.
sentences.zh: 而巡回赛基本上无视了他们。

sentences.en: Ignores them?
sentences.zh: 无视了他们？

sentences.en: Yeah, that did not sit well in Riyadh, it turns out.
sentences.zh: 是的，事实证明，利雅得方面对此很不高兴。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why did the PGA Tour close the door in their face?
sentences.zh: 为什么PGA巡回赛要把他们拒之门外？

sentences.en: Well, they didn't need them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们不需要他们。

sentences.en: They thought, we control the game's highest, most elite levels.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，我们控制着这项运动最高、最精英的水平。

sentences.en: We've got a gazillion dollars already, it seemed.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有数不清的钱了，看起来是这样。

sentences.en: We don't need your help.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要你们的帮助。

sentences.en: We've got everything as fine as it is.
sentences.zh: 一切都很好。

sentences.en: And that's just kind of the arrogance you sometimes see in professional sports.
sentences.zh: 这就是你在职业体育中偶尔会看到的傲慢。

sentences.en: So the PGA Tour essentially rebuffs the Saudis.
sentences.zh: 所以PGA巡回赛基本上拒绝了沙特人。

sentences.en: But they don't give up on this idea that they could play a big role in golf.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有放弃在高尔夫领域发挥重要作用的想法。

sentences.en: And it turns out there is a hugely receptive audience to this kind of idea among some of the world's top players.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在一些世界顶级球员中，这种想法有着巨大的受众。

sentences.en: And why are the players so receptive?
sentences.zh: 为什么球员们如此容易接受？

sentences.en: For decades and decades, there have been arguments in golf about the economic structure.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，高尔夫界一直存在关于经济结构的争论。

sentences.en: How people get paid, how they make money, how the wealth is spread around.
sentences.zh: 人们如何获得报酬，如何赚钱，财富如何分配。

sentences.en: And the PGA Tour had been pretty content not to really mess with what was working for them.
sentences.zh: PGA巡回赛一直很满足于不去改变对他们有效的东西。

sentences.en: But that didn't mean the players were happy with it.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着球员们对此感到满意。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of discontent bubbling up among the players.
sentences.zh: 球员们中间积聚了大量的不满。

sentences.en: There was a lot of nerves, a lot of anger, a lot of frustration.
sentences.zh: 有很多紧张、愤怒和沮丧。

sentences.en: And what was that anger and frustration about?
sentences.zh: 那种愤怒和沮丧是关于什么的？

sentences.en: So the traditional way of winning money through professional golf, she played these golf tournaments.
sentences.zh: 职业高尔夫赚钱的传统方式是参加这些高尔夫锦标赛。

sentences.en: And really, you only make money if you do well.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，只有表现好你才能赚钱。

sentences.en: You don't get a baseline salary just for being a member of the PGA Tour historically.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，你作为PGA巡回赛的成员并没有底薪。

sentences.en: And you don't even just get a salary for showing up or a payment for showing up.
sentences.zh: 甚至连出场费都没有。

sentences.en: You have to perform well enough to play the full tournament.
sentences.zh: 你必须表现足够好才能打完整个锦标赛。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So it's not like baseball or football where you have a contract and you get money just by being part of a team.
sentences.zh: 所以这不像棒球或橄榄球，你有合同，只要是球队的一员就能拿到钱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It is essentially pay for performance in professional golf.
sentences.zh: 职业高尔夫本质上是按表现付费。

sentences.en: Now, there are guys who would, you know, they make money through some sponsorship deals, equipment deals, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 当然，有些人可以通过一些赞助协议、装备协议等方式赚钱。

sentences.en: But the PGA Tour money, the money that comes from actually playing the sport, was contingent on how well you played.
sentences.zh: 但PGA巡回赛的钱，即通过实际打球赚到的钱，取决于你的表现。

sentences.en: So that meant only a handful of players were making the truly big bucks.
sentences.zh: 这意味着只有少数球员能赚到真正的大钱。

sentences.en: There are people who are early career golfers, people who are never going to rise to Tiger Woods level stardom, who they don't make much money.
sentences.zh: 有些是职业生涯早期的球员，有些永远无法达到泰格·伍兹那种明星地位，他们赚不到多少钱。

sentences.en: Some of them even lose money on playing golf.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至因为打高尔夫而赔钱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So into this steps the Saudis.
sentences.zh: 所以沙特人介入了。

sentences.en: And what do they do with this discontent?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何利用这种不满的？

sentences.en: How do they use it?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何利用它的？

sentences.en: Well, they decide to start their own league, which becomes Live Golf, as we know it now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们决定创办自己的联赛，也就是我们现在所知的LIV高尔夫。

sentences.en: And they know that in order to take on the establishment, take on the PGA Tour, this entrenched monopoly, they've got to get players.
sentences.zh: 他们知道，为了挑战建制派，挑战PGA巡回赛这个根深蒂固的垄断者，他们必须争取到球员。

sentences.en: There is no way around that.
sentences.zh: 这是绕不开的。

sentences.en: So they think big because they're the Saudis and they have the money to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想得很大，因为他们是沙特人，他们有钱这样做。

sentences.en: They think big about people like Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson and Rory McIlroy and Brooks Koepka.
sentences.zh: 他们想到了泰格·伍兹、菲尔·米克尔森、罗里·麦克罗伊和布鲁克斯·科普卡这样的人。

sentences.en: They want the biggest names to play the game.
sentences.zh: 他们想要最响亮的名字来参加比赛。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So do they get any of these guys?
sentences.zh: 那么他们争取到这些人了吗？

sentences.en: Well, the rumors start coming fast and furious all over professional golfs, who might be willing to join, live, who might be willing to leave the PGA Tour.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于谁愿意加入LIV，谁愿意离开PGA巡回赛的传言在职业高尔夫界传得沸沸扬扬。

sentences.en: And then in February of 2022, it really burst into the Open when Phil Mickelson, who is, by all accounts, one of the finest golfers ever to play the game,
sentences.zh: 然后在2022年2月，当菲尔·米克尔森——据各方评价，他是这项运动有史以来最优秀的球员之一——

sentences.en: won the Masters Tournament, won the PGA Championship, won the British Open.
sentences.zh: 赢得了大师赛、PGA锦标赛和英国公开赛。

sentences.en: And he's quoted in a new book that was coming out at the time, essentially saying that it didn't matter what the Saudis' baggage was.
sentences.zh: 他在当时出版的一本新书中被引用，基本上说沙特人的包袱并不重要。

sentences.en: He was interested.
sentences.zh: 他很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Let me just quote for you directly what Mickelson said to this book author.
sentences.zh: 让我直接引用米克尔森对那位书作者说的话。

sentences.en: Their scary mother, then he added a swear word, to get involved with it.
sentences.zh: 他们是可怕的混蛋，然后他加了一个脏话，要和他们搅在一起。

sentences.en: We know they killed Khashoggi and have a horrible record on human rights.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们杀了卡舒吉，在人权方面记录糟糕。

sentences.en: They execute people over there for being gay.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里因为同性恋而处决人。

sentences.en: Knowing all of this, why would I even consider this?
sentences.zh: 既然知道这一切，我为什么还要考虑这个？

sentences.en: Because this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to reshape how the PGA Tour operates.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个千载难逢的机会，可以重塑PGA巡回赛的运作方式。

sentences.en: So he's kind of saying, this is a very bad regime, but I hate the PGA more.
sentences.zh: 所以他是在说，这是一个非常糟糕的政权，但我更讨厌PGA。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And in fact, he really goes on this extended rant about the PGA Tour.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他确实对PGA巡回赛进行了一番长篇大论的抨击。

sentences.en: He's got essentially a greatest hits list of grievances that he's been nursing for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他基本上有一份他长期以来一直怀恨在心的不满清单。

sentences.en: And he talks about how they're manipulative, they're coercive, they strong-arm people.
sentences.zh: 他谈到他们是如何操纵、强迫、威逼人们的。

sentences.en: He says Jay Monaghan, the commissioner, you know, is a decent guy, but he won't do what's right for the players in the end.
sentences.zh: 他说专员杰伊·莫纳汉是个不错的人，但最终他不会为球员做正确的事。

sentences.en: And then he talks about how the Saudi money has given the players the leverage they have always wanted.
sentences.zh: 然后他谈到沙特资金如何给了球员他们一直想要的筹码。

sentences.en: So, Saudi dictators helping golfers get leverage over PGA dictators.
sentences.zh: 所以，沙特独裁者帮助高尔夫球手获得了对抗PGA独裁者的筹码。

sentences.en: That's effectively what he's saying.
sentences.zh: 他实际上就是这个意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, that pretty much sums it up.
sentences.zh: 是的，这基本上总结了这一点。

sentences.en: So how does the golf world react?
sentences.zh: 那么高尔夫界有什么反应？

sentences.en: Well, it was about as ferocious of a reaction as you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，反应之激烈超乎你的想象。

sentences.en: Saudi Golf League, Bill Mickelson, holy cow.
sentences.zh: 沙特高尔夫联赛，菲尔·米克尔森，天哪。

sentences.en: He's facing some backlash, losing a big sponsor over his comments he made, supporting a Saudi-backed golf tour.
sentences.zh: 他面临着一些反弹，因为他支持沙特支持的高尔夫巡回赛的言论，失去了一位大赞助商。

sentences.en: Sponsors are furious.
sentences.zh: 赞助商们非常愤怒。

sentences.en: People are condemning Mickelson left and right.
sentences.zh: 人们到处都在谴责米克尔森。

sentences.en: Several PGA stars, including Rory McIlroy, blasted Mickelson's comments.
sentences.zh: 包括罗里·麦克罗伊在内的几位PGA明星抨击了米克尔森的言论。

sentences.en: I thought they were naive, selfish, egotistical, ignorant.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它们天真、自私、自负、无知。

sentences.en: You know, watching Pat Perez there react and Justin Thomas, it's almost like they're sort of laughing at Phil, as if he sort of lost his mind.

sentences.en: He makes the jump over to Liv.
sentences.zh: 在Liv的第一个赛季结束时，他已经赚了超过3500万美元的奖金。

sentences.en: By the end of the first season of Liv, he had made more than $35 million in prize money.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那真是钱啊。

sentences.en: Holy moly, that is money.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，看，金钱的军备竞赛已经来到了职业高尔夫领域，而且在宏观层面上，它几乎没有任何预警就到来了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, look, the arms race of money has come to professional golf, and it came with very, very little warning in the grand scheme of things.
sentences.zh: 所以现实情况是，PGA巡回赛开始感受到这种财务上的刺痛。

sentences.en: So the reality is, the PGA Tour, it starts to feel the financial sting of this.
sentences.zh: 就像，他们突然要支付比预期多出许多许多许多百万美元的费用。

sentences.en: Like, they are suddenly shelling out many, many, many millions of dollars, more than they had anticipated doing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以PGA在金钱方面无法与沙特人抗衡，你知道，所以这不是他们的优势。

sentences.en: Okay, so PGA can't keep up with the Saudis in the money department, you know, so that's not on their side.
sentences.zh: 但他们有什么优势吗？

sentences.en: But do they have anything going for them at all?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们有一些优势。

sentences.en: Well, they've got a few things.
sentences.zh: 因为他们有历史的论据，你知道，我们是PGA巡回赛，我们已经存在很久了，你了解我们，你喜欢我们，你应该容忍我们。

sentences.en: Because they've got the argument of history, you know, we're the PGA Tour, we've been around, you know us, you like us, we should tolerate us.
sentences.zh: 他们有这个。

sentences.en: They've got that.
sentences.zh: 然后还有PGA巡回赛一直在使用的这个因素，看看Liv Golf的钱是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: And then there's also this element the PGA Tour keeps using of, look where the money is coming from for Liv Golf.
sentences.zh: 他们真的把自己包裹在道德的外衣里，说，你知道，我们的钱是纯洁的。

sentences.en: And they really wrap themselves in this cloak of morality and say, you know, our money is pure.
sentences.zh: 它来自电视转播协议。

sentences.en: It comes from TV deals.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: It comes from traditional sponsorships.
sentences.zh: 这源于传统的赞助模式。

sentences.en: It's American money, for the most part.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，这都是美国的资金。

sentences.en: The PGA Tour commissioner at one point says, have you ever had to apologize for being a member of the PGA Tour?
sentences.zh: PGA巡回赛的专员曾一度说，你是否曾因为自己是PGA巡回赛的一员而不得不道歉？

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Meaning our red-blooded American money has none of that Saudi stain.
sentences.zh: 意思是说，我们纯正的美国资金没有沾染上那种沙特的污点。

sentences.en: That's exactly the implication.
sentences.zh: 这正是其中的言外之意。

sentences.en: There are family members of 9-11 victims coming out and questioning how could any golfer sleep at night if he takes money from Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 有“9·11”事件受害者的家属站出来质疑，如果高尔夫球手接受沙特的钱，他们怎么能睡得着觉。

sentences.en: There are some protests.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些抗议活动。

sentences.en: This whole thing, it goes from just being an economic spat in golf to having these really freighted emotional implications and storylines associated with it.
sentences.zh: 整件事已经从高尔夫领域的一场经济争端，演变成了带有沉重情感色彩和叙事背景的事件。

sentences.en: So the PGA Tour is howling with moral outrage.
sentences.zh: 所以PGA巡回赛正在进行道德上的强烈谴责。

sentences.en: But eventually we learn that the two actually started meeting and talking about, could there be a way to work together?
sentences.zh: 但最终我们得知，双方其实已经开始会面并讨论：有没有可能合作？

sentences.en: So publicly, moral outrage.
sentences.zh: 所以公开场合是道德谴责。

sentences.en: Privately, something entirely different.
sentences.zh: 私下里却是完全另一回事。

sentences.en: That's what it came to.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样发展的。

sentences.en: It all started when a member of the PGA Tour's board messaged the governor of the Saudi Sovereign Wealth Fund and said, I'd like to set up a call and hopefully a meeting with you.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于PGA巡回赛董事会的一名成员给沙特主权财富基金的负责人发了条信息，说：我想和你通个电话，希望能和你见一面。

sentences.en: And then they were off to the races.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就一拍即合了。

sentences.en: Because I'm not sure I can convey just how secretive this deal was until it was announced.
sentences.zh: 因为我无法形容在宣布之前，这笔交易是多么的保密。

sentences.en: You know, there were members of the PGA Tour board who did not know about it until right before it was announced.
sentences.zh: 要知道，PGA巡回赛董事会里有些成员直到宣布前一刻才知道这件事。

sentences.en: This was a handful of people who cut a deal and then told the world, this is the new world order in golf.
sentences.zh: 这只是少数几个人达成了一项协议，然后告诉全世界：这就是高尔夫的新秩序。

sentences.en: Given the complexity of what we were dealing with, it's not uncommon that the circle of information is very tight.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们所处理事务的复杂性，信息圈子非常封闭并不罕见。

sentences.en: And the PGA Tour commissioner, who was central to all these negotiations, he suddenly finds himself on defense.
sentences.zh: 而作为所有这些谈判核心的PGA巡回赛专员，突然发现自己处于被动防守的境地。

sentences.en: And I recognize everything that, you know, that I've said in the past and in my prior position.
sentences.zh: 我承认我过去在之前的立场上所说的一切。

sentences.en: He goes and holds this press conference and he says, I know you're going to think I'm a hypocrite.
sentences.zh: 他召开新闻发布会说：我知道你们会认为我是个伪君子。

sentences.en: And any time I've said anything, I said it with the information I had at that moment.
sentences.zh: 我所说的每一句话，都是基于我当时掌握的信息。

sentences.en: And I said it based on someone that's trying to compete for the PGA Tour and our players.
sentences.zh: 我所说的一切，都是站在一个试图为PGA巡回赛和我们的球员争取竞争优势的人的角度。

sentences.en: They said, I know you're going to think that I just did this dirty deed.
sentences.zh: 他们说：我知道你们会认为我做了这件肮脏的勾当。

sentences.en: I accept those criticisMs.
sentences.zh: 我接受这些批评。

sentences.en: But this is what I thought the game needed to survive.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是我认为这项运动生存下去所需要的。

sentences.en: I mean, it was very much a business argument.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在很大程度上是一个商业论点。

sentences.en: It put us in a position where, again, we're in control.
sentences.zh: 它让我们再次处于掌控地位。

sentences.en: We have an investor.
sentences.zh: 我们有了一位投资者。

sentences.en: And ultimately, you know, for the game, we're moving forward constructively.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，为了这项运动，我们正在建设性地向前迈进。

sentences.en: And if you look at the values of the game, I think that's what the situation warranted.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这项运动的价值观，我认为这就是当时的情况所需要的。

sentences.en: The PGA Tour, for the longest time, they got to claim this was a battle of morality.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，PGA巡回赛一直声称这是一场道德之战。

sentences.en: This was about the integrity of the game.
sentences.zh: 这是关于这项运动的完整性。

sentences.en: The Saudi element made them a convenient boogeyman.
sentences.zh: 沙特因素使他们成为了一个方便的替罪羊。

sentences.en: But they ceded that argument last week.
sentences.zh: 但他们上周放弃了这个论点。

sentences.en: Alan, now that you've taught me all about golf, I'm kind of curious what it means for the game.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，既然你已经教会了我关于高尔夫的一切，我很好奇这对这项运动意味着什么。

sentences.en: Like, is it totally changed?
sentences.zh: 比如，它彻底改变了吗？

sentences.en: What happens to golf?
sentences.zh: 高尔夫会变成什么样？

sentences.en: So, the wealth fund's governor is about to be the chairman of this new company that's been created.
sentences.zh: 所以，这位财富基金的负责人即将成为这家新成立公司的董事长。

sentences.en: And the Saudis essentially hold the purse strings for men's professional golf.
sentences.zh: 而沙特人基本上掌握了男子职业高尔夫的财政大权。

sentences.en: You know, at this point, you can't really say it was a complete conquering of golf by the Saudis because the PGA Tour still has a big and consequential role.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这一点上，你不能说沙特人完全征服了高尔夫，因为PGA巡回赛仍然扮演着重要且关键的角色。

sentences.en: But if I had told you a year ago that we would be at this point now, people would have laughed me out of the room.
sentences.zh: 但如果一年前我告诉你我们现在会走到这一步，人们会把我笑出房间的。

sentences.en: I mean, the Saudis have long wanted to be seen as not a pariah nation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，沙特人长期以来一直希望被视为一个正常的国家，而不是被排斥的国家。

sentences.en: You know, President Biden had condemned them as a pariah.
sentences.zh: 你知道，拜登总统曾谴责他们是一个被排斥的国家。

sentences.en: The PGA Tour deal doesn't instantly lift the whole cloud off Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: PGA巡回赛的协议并不能瞬间消除沙特阿拉伯头上的阴云。

sentences.en: No sports deal is ever going to do that.
sentences.zh: 没有任何体育协议能做到这一点。

sentences.en: But it's a part of a process of being accepted by Western society.
sentences.zh: 但这是被西方社会接受的过程的一部分。

sentences.en: It's a form of soft power.
sentences.zh: 这是一种软实力。

sentences.en: That was always the idea behind some of these sports investments we're seeing out of the Persian Gulf.
sentences.zh: 这始终是我们在波斯湾看到的某些体育投资背后的理念。

sentences.en: And now the Saudis have a pretty good playbook for how to do this in other sports if they want to.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果沙特人愿意，他们已经有了一套非常好的剧本，可以在其他体育项目中如法炮制。

sentences.en: They saw flaws on an economic model that were apparent for all to see, and they capitalized on it.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了经济模式中显而易见的缺陷，并利用了这一点。

sentences.en: They took advantage of them, and that could be a recipe for trouble for other sports around the world.
sentences.zh: 他们利用了这些缺陷，这可能成为全球其他体育运动的麻烦之源。

sentences.en: Like, upstart with deep pockets disrupts established monopolistic power that took for granted its position for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 就像资金雄厚的初创公司颠覆了长期以来理所当然地占据垄断地位的既得利益者。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, just like you would see a startup in Silicon Valley challenging an entrenched player, we see how it can happen in sports.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像你在硅谷看到初创公司挑战老牌巨头一样，我们看到了这种情况如何在体育界发生。

sentences.en: We see how you can do it with, you know, billions of dollars from a sovereign wealth fund.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了如何利用主权财富基金的数十亿美元做到这一点。

sentences.en: And if you're a sports executive, you're thinking, how do I make sure that I can't be caught asleep at the wheel?
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名体育高管，你会想：我该如何确保自己不会在睡梦中被突袭？

sentences.en: Because in a lot of ways, that's what the PGA Tour was.
sentences.zh: 因为在很多方面，PGA巡回赛就是这样。

sentences.en: The PGA Tour thought it was invincible.
sentences.zh: PGA巡回赛曾以为自己是不可战胜的。

sentences.en: What we have now learned is that it only takes a year or so of really public badgering and a whole lot of money, and then the PGA Tour is no longer invincible.
sentences.zh: 我们现在了解到，只需要一年左右的公开施压和大量的金钱，PGA巡回赛就不再是不可战胜的了。

sentences.en: Alan, thank you.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Today, the PGA Tour will begin their first major tournament since the deal was announced, this year's U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，PGA巡回赛将开始自协议宣布以来的首场大型赛事，即今年的美国公开赛。

sentences.en: Open.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，PGA巡回赛突然宣布其专员杰伊·莫纳汉因“医疗状况”正在康复中，并将暂时离职。

sentences.en: It follows a sudden announcement by the PGA Tour that its commissioner, Jay Monaghan, was, quote, recuperating from a medical situation and that he would temporarily step aside.
sentences.zh: 声明没有给出他回归的时间表。

sentences.en: It did not give a timeline for his return.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged, the first pause after raising them 10 times in a row over many months.
sentences.zh: 美联储官员表示，他们暂停加息是为了评估经济对抑制需求和控制通胀的快速行动有何反应。

sentences.en: Fed officials said they were pausing to assess how the economy is reacting to the rapid campaign to slow demand and to control inflation.
sentences.zh: 但美联储官员仍对通胀感到担忧，并在周三暗示今年可能会再加息两次。

sentences.en: But Fed officials remain concerned about inflation, indicating on Wednesday that they may make two more rate increases this year.
